entities.name: Leopold Karl von Kollonitsch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leopold Karl von Kollonitsch or Lipót Kollonich was a cardinal of the Holy Roman Church, Archbishop of Kalocsa and later of Esztergom, and Primate of Hungary. Also a count of the Holy Roman Empire, he was a leading figure of the Hungarian Counter-Reformation.
